entities.name: Stephen A. Hurlbut
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Stephen Augustus Hurlbut was an attorney and politician, who commanded the U.S. Army of the Gulf in the American Civil War. Afterward, he continued to serve as a politician and also as a diplomat.
